newsitem.title: INDIA: India PM to reply to debate at 1530 GM-Speaker.
newsitem.headline: India PM to reply to debate at 1530 GM-Speaker.

text.p: Indian Prime Minister H. D. Deve Gowda will reply to the debate on a vote of confidence in his United Front coalition at 9 p.m. (2130 GMT), parliament speaker P.A. Sangma said on Friday.

The debate, originally scheduled to end around 8 p.m., was extended as some speakers had not made their scheduled speeches. Voting on the motion was scheduled to take place after the reply by the prime minister.
